create_mixture_distribution: create a MixtureSameFamily distribution from a categorical mixture and batched components distribution
sample_from_mixture: sample from a MixtureSameFamily distribution using a PRNG key and sample count
compute_log_prob: compute the log probability of a value under a MixtureSameFamily distribution
calculate_mixture_mean: calculate the weighted mean of a MixtureSameFamily distribution across all components
calculate_mixture_variance: calculate the total variance of a MixtureSameFamily using the law of total variance
